nom: Face Republic Blooming Rose Melt & Remove Pore Cleansing Oil

avis.titre: Gentle & Effective Cleanser — A Win for My Skin
avis.texte: I’ve been using the Blooming Rose Melt & Remove Pore Cleansing Oil for a few weeks now — and I’m really pleased with how it performs. It removes waterproof makeup and sunscreen effortlessly, even stubborn mascara, without tugging or irritating my skin. The texture is lightweight and silky, and it spreads easily. During and after use, my skin feels clean but not stripped — just balanced and soft. My pores seem less clogged, and over time I’ve noticed fewer blackheads (especially around my nose and chin). I also love that it’s vegan and feels gentle enough for daily use. For anyone looking for a reliable oil-based cleanser that doubles as a sebum, blackhead, and makeup remover — this one’s a keeper.

avis.titre: Effective makeup removal and pore care, but not truly clean beauty
avis.texte: Testing Context: I received the Face Republic Blooming Rose Cleansing Oil through Amazon's Vine program for honest evaluation. I've been using it as my first cleanse in a double-cleansing routine for 4 weeks, testing on waterproof mascara, long-wear foundation, and daily sunscreen. What Works Well: Excellent makeup removal power - dissolves even stubborn waterproof mascara without harsh rubbing The rose scent is pleasant and subtle, not overpowering like some floral skincare products Emulsifies beautifully with water, rinsing clean without leaving an oily residue Noticeably helps with sebaceous filaments and blackheads on my nose area after consistent use 150ml bottle provides good value and lasts about 2-3 months with daily use Pump dispenser is hygienic and dispenses the right amount (2-3 pumps covers entire face) Gentle enough for daily use without causing irritation or breakouts Important Clarification: Despite marketing suggesting natural/vegan positioning, the ingredient list contains several synthetic components Not truly "clean beauty" by strict standards - includes ingredients like PEG compounds and synthetic fragrances Vegan claim appears accurate, but don't expect an all-natural formulation Areas for Improvement: Packaging could be more transparent about synthetic ingredients for ingredient-conscious consumers Price point is higher than comparable K-beauty cleansing oils with similar performance Rose fragrance, while pleasant, may not suit those preferring fragranc

avis.titre: A Hydrating and Effective Pore-Cleansing Experience
avis.texte: The first thing that caught my attention was the pleasant rose scent – it's soothing and refreshing, making the cleansing experience even more enjoyable. The oil itself is lightweight and glides effortlessly onto the skin, effortlessly melting away makeup and impurities. I find that it effectively removes even the most stubborn waterproof mascara without leaving my eyes feeling greasy or irritated. The formula is also gentle enough for daily use, which is a major plus for me. One of the standout features of this product is its pore-cleansing capabilities. After using it consistently, I've noticed a reduction in the appearance of blackheads and sebum buildup, giving my skin a more balanced and healthy look. The oil doesn't leave my skin feeling oily or greasy, but rather, it leaves it feeling soft, supple, and hydrated. However, there are a couple of minor drawbacks that prevent me from giving it a perfect rating. Firstly, the bottle's design could be more user-friendly – I find that the pump dispenser can sometimes be a bit finicky, and I've had to use a little extra force to get the product out. Secondly, while the formula is vegan, it does contain some fragrance, which may not be ideal for those with sensitive skin or allergies.

avis.titre: Erases makeup like magicErases makeup like magic
avis.texte: I'm a big fan of skincare products from Korea, and I'm happy to add this to my list of favorites. First of all, the basics: This is a glass bottle with a lockable pump top. It comes in a sealed box, with the expiration date (nearly three years out) stamped on the bottom. If you open up the box, there is a chart to help identify your skin type, and a QR code for a link to determine your recommended skincare routine. Depending on your skin type, it tells you exactly which products to use in your morning and nighttime routines. Nice! The oil is a lovely pink color and is said to be rose scented. I am typically not a fan of fragranced products on my face, but I did not detect even a light scent with this, which was great. The natural plant derived oils (rose flower, rice bran, sunflower, and others) remove makeup cleanly, but don't cause any residual drying. The process is to rub the oil onto your dry face and rinse. I accidentally got a tiny bit in my eyes and it took a few minutes to get the film to clear completely, so lesson learned. I'll be more careful henceforth. I use a disposable wash cloth and warm water to complete the process and proceed to the next step in my routine. I like that this oil gently removes makeup but is non-comedogenic, so there is no worry about clogged pores. It does a great job.

avis.titre: It's an oil... but it did a great job at making my face feel CLEAN!It's an oil... but it did a great job at making my fa
avis.texte: This facial cleaning oil is Made in Korea and comes in a clear plastic bottle with a pump top. I wasn't sure what to expect because I usually use foaming facial cleansers and not oil facial cleansers. I have sensitive skin that tends to be on the dry side, but I was concerned this oil might clog my pores. It did no such thing! I have no idea how oil can clean, but this stuff really performed well! It's thin in consistency, so I just put one pump in the palm of my hand, rubbed my hands together, and put it on my face. After I massaged it on my dry face (per the instructions), I rinsed it off. My face really felt clean and refreshed, not oily or greasy at all! I found the scent to be very lightly perfumed and nothing too overpowering or lingering at all. The ingredients also seem pretty healthy. I've attached a photo because the ingredients aren't listed in the product description. Overall I'm very happy with the cleansing oil and it works really great to clean and hydrate my sensitive, dry skin. It also has an expiration date 3 years in the future, so that's excellent too.

This is a good Korean facial cleansing oil that is effective at removing makeup. The texture is light and its got a somewhat floral scent. It leaves my skin feeling refreshed and moisturized after a good rinse. You don't have to use too much either so the bottle should last quite a while.

This is an effective cleanser, especially for heavy makeup, but despite the rose in the name, the only scent I get is from the sunflower seed oil. It's not unpleasant, it just is reminiscent of putting cooking oil on my face. There's barely a scent of rose oil at all despite it being the first ingredient in the list. I would not order this again.

Pros: + This cleansing oil effectively removes heavy makeup and waterproof mascara without irritating my sensitive skin. + It leaves my skin feeling clean, hydrated, and non-greasy after rinsing. + The texture is lightweight and glides easily, making it perfect for a double cleanse routine. + A little goes a long way, and the generous bottle size adds value to the purchase. + It has a subtle or minimal scent, which I appreciate as someone sensitive to fragrances. Cons: - Despite the rose branding, the scent reminds me more of cooking oil than a floral fragrance.

A nice Korean facial cleansing oil with a slightly floral, mostly neutral oily fragrance. I incorporate this as part of my double cleansing routine. The oil cleanser is effective at cleaning out my pores and sebum. Works just as well as any other oil cleanser that I've tried. Happy with the results and I think that it is a decent value for the amount( currently $16 for 5 oz)

avis.titre: Great gentle all natural makeup remover!
avis.texte: The packaging and bottle for this makeup remover is adorable - but it also works amazing! I wear waterproof mascara frequently as I work on the beach. There’s no smell really, other than from the all natural ingredients. It’s very gentle and gets all of my makeup off quickly and doesn’t require hard rubbing which is so nice. My old makeup remover I had to rub hard and would always have red/pink eyelids that were irritated. LOVING this remover!

avis.titre: Face Republic Blooming Rose Melt Cleansing Oil
avis.texte: Very nice cleansing oil from Face Republic. Light scent, nothing overwhelming. Very easy to use, cleansed my face and made it feel soft and pretty afterwards. Functions just as it says it does. No tightness or dryness, just clean soft skin. Such a value add to my skincare product collection. My new favorite cleansing oil!
